annotations.title: Start a business from an idea

description: Use when the user wants to start a business or launch an offer from an idea ("start a coffee subscription called Bean Club"). Pass the idea in their words, plus name, domain, country and budget if given. Saves it on the brand and answers the launch plan (brand, a landing page the AI in the chat writes and Hermoso hosts, its address, email on the domain, payments, posts, ads, tracking), each step with its status, the next call and any link the user must click. Calling again picks up where it left off. After each step call business_status and show its checklist. Free.

budget.description: a budget they mentioned, in their words

domain.description: a domain they want or own

idea.description: the idea in the user's words (needed the first time)

name: start_business
